findings.desc: edge: cli-engine.ts:3581-3583 if gitCli(['add'] or 'rm') throws inside the conflicted-paths resolution loop, the exception propagates out with no merge --abort call, leaving the story worktree in a mid-merge state (MERGE_HEAD present) indefinitely. The still-unmerged guard at 3595 and the abort at 3596 are only reachable after the loop completes cleanly; a throw inside the loop bypasses them entirely. Recovery requires manual 'git merge --abort' in the worktree.
